choose.when:
SELECT id, 'TENDER' AS order_kind, project_id, enterprise_id, insurance_type_id, org_id, region_code, region_name, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM tender_order WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'PERFORMANCE' AS order_kind, project_id, enterprise_id, insurance_type_id, org_id, region_code, region_name, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM performance_order WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT id, 'TENDER' AS order_kind, project_id, enterprise_id, insurance_type_id, org_id, region_code, region_name, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM tender_order WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT id, 'PERFORMANCE' AS order_kind, project_id, enterprise_id, insurance_type_id, org_id, region_code, region_name, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM performance_order WHERE 1 = 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT id, 'TENDER' AS order_kind, project_id, enterprise_id, insurance_type_id, org_id, region_code, region_name, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM tender_order WHERE 1 = 0 AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period
DATE_FORMAT(apply_date, '%Y') AS period
DATE_FORMAT(apply_date, '%Y-%m') AS period
, COUNT(*) AS orderCount , COALESCE(SUM(guarantee_amount), 0) AS guaranteeAmount , COALESCE(SUM(premium_amount), 0) AS premiumAmount FROM (
) merged GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT o.region_code AS regionCode, MAX(o.region_name) AS regionName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.guarantee_amount), 0) AS guaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(o.premium_amount), 0) AS premiumAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.enterprise_id) AS enterpriseCount FROM (
) o LEFT JOIN enterprise et ON et.id = o.enterprise_id AND et.region_code = o.region_code AND et.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.region_code ORDER BY `orderCount` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.insurance_type_id AS insuranceTypeId, MAX(t.type_code) AS typeCode, MAX(t.type_name) AS typeName, MAX(t.category) AS category, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.guarantee_amount), 0) AS guaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(o.premium_amount), 0) AS premiumAmount FROM (
) o LEFT JOIN insurance_type t ON t.id = o.insurance_type_id GROUP BY o.insurance_type_id ORDER BY `orderCount` DESC, o.insurance_type_id ASC

SELECT o.org_id AS orgId, MAX(g.org_code) AS orgCode, MAX(g.org_name) AS orgName, o.region_code AS regionCode, MAX(o.region_name) AS regionName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.guarantee_amount), 0) AS guaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(o.premium_amount), 0) AS premiumAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.enterprise_id) AS enterpriseCount FROM (
) o LEFT JOIN sys_org g ON g.id = o.org_id GROUP BY o.org_id, o.region_code ORDER BY `orderCount` DESC, o.org_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
